note: Purchasable / datasheet components for the cold-gas rocket-car design stage. verified=true: every figure in 'specs' and mass_kg was read in the cited page/PDF by the catalog author on checked_on. null = not published in the source read. unit_cost_usd is null everywhere: no cited price was found. NOT live web research.

thruster.name: 2 lbf cold gas thruster 48003040
thruster.notes: Datasheet: 2.0 lbf at 260 psia GN2, 0.0267 lbm/s, 0.83 lbm (converted to SI by the catalog author). Flown on the Space Shuttle MMU.

thruster.name: Cold gas thruster 058-118 (0.8 lbf)
thruster.notes: Datasheet column 'Model No. 058-118': 3.6 N at 15.7 bar GN2, 23 g. Flown on SAFER.

thruster.name: Low power cold gas thruster V1E10703-01 (5 N)
thruster.notes: Datasheet: 5.0 N at 3000 psia (converted). Mass not published in the page read.

valve.name: ICS solenoid valve SV13-20-C (2-way poppet, NC)
valve.notes: Hydraulic-oil flow rating only (21.8 cSt oil, 49 C); no gas/N2 flow or Cv in the datasheet read, so it cannot be compared with a gas mass-flow requirement.

tank.name: Type 4 composite cylinder 9.0 L, 300 bar
tank.notes: Bare cylinder, aluminium boss, 3.90 +-0.24 kg; PET liner, carbon fibre + epoxy; nitrogen approved (UN 1066); test 450 bar.

tank.name: Type 4 composite cylinder 3.0 L, 300 bar
tank.notes: Bare cylinder, aluminium boss, 1.53 +-0.09 kg. Diameter 120 +-2 mm read from the drawing text.

tank.name: HDRX-400 Type IV composite cylinder 40 L, 300 bar
tank.notes: Catalog rating SF 3.0, burst 900 bar. The same page lists R&D configurations at lower safety factor (e.g. 450 bar, not certified).

category_notes.regulator: No regulator with a read spec page: the VACCO 48003040 datasheet only names 'a VACCO Regulator/Relief Valve'. Left empty on purpose (never invent a part).

6061-T6.note: AA typical values as listed by Glemco (2.7 g/cc, tensile yield 276 MPa, shear strength 207 MPa, E 68.9 GPa).
